description: This is a unit test class for the EmployeeWorkExperienceDao component in the OrangeHRM project. It contains test cases for CRUD operations and search functionality related to employee work experience data.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class to verify the functionality of EmployeeWorkExperienceDao, including methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching employee work experience records.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, including instantiation of the DAO object and fixture data population.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeWorkExperienceById
methods.description: Verifies that fetching employee work experience by ID returns expected data.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Tests deletion of employee work experience records by IDs.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Tests searching employee work experiences with specific filter parameters.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeWorkExperienceWithLimit
methods.description: Tests searching employee work experiences with a limit on returned records.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Checks that saving a new employee work experience works correctly and returns the saved object with expected values.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Verifies updating an existing employee work experience record.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeWorkExperiencesCount
methods.description: Tests retrieving the count of employee work experience records matching a filter.
